summary: Scaling and management differ by installation type; OpenShift offers the most flexibility and built-in metrics and log aggregation. Scaling up horizontally on OpenShift means adjusting replicas per component and adding worker nodes without disruption, while VM-based and containerized installs require editing the inventory and re-running the whole installer, which restarts the platform.
questions: How do I scale AAP on OpenShift versus VMs?
Does adding nodes to a VM-based AAP install cause downtime?
Which AAP installation type is easiest to scale?
